subject: Spectra renewal + expansion recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@spectrahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Spectra renewal + expansion recap & next steps

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) Current usage & renewal
- Observed Q2 token usage: ~1.2B tokens (see attached 2027_Q2_usage_report.csv).
- Current contract renewal date: 2027-09-15. You indicated you'd prefer a single vendor renewal/expansion decision in August.

2) Primary pain points you called out
- Latency spikes on high-concurrency inference for clinical search workflows (peak 95th p50 > 600ms).
- Cost unpredictability for large batch jobs (billing spikes for nightly reports).
- Need for tighter ACLs and SSO integration for new engineering team onboarding.

3) Proposed expansion path (high level)
- Add Redwood Dedicated reserved capacity for your search and summarization workloads (reduces p95 latency, more predictable unit cost).
- Add embeddings endpoint + similarity search pipeline for clinical search (Connor will scope indexing cadence and storage).
- Implement SSO + SCIM and provide SOC2 artifacts for procurement (Stephanie will surface the docs).

4) Timeline & next steps
- Aug 10: Technical deep-dive (Connor lead) to scope embedding throughput and KV cache sizing. 
- Aug 12: I’ll send a price/commit proposal and a redlined contract template for legal review.
- Target: finalize commercial terms by Aug 20 so procurement can complete before the Sep 15 renewal.

ACTIONS: 
- Connor: prep deep-dive deck + sizing questions for Aug 10 (cc'd).
- Stephanie: attach SOC2 and SSO integration checklist to the HubSpot deal.
- Alicia / Spectra: confirm Aug 10 availability and any additional stakeholders (legal / security).

Attaching: 2027_Q2_usage_report.csv (usage by product/route).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the calendar invite for Aug 10 once I hear back on times.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

--
Redwood Inference — making inference predictable and economical for production workloads
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@spectrahealth.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectra renewal + expansion recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications from my side.

- Confirmed: Aug 10 works for a deep-dive (10am PT preferred). I’ll invite our infra lead (Daniel Park) and procurement (Sara Li) — planning to loop them into the technical call only.
- Can you share a ballpark committed pricing range for Dedicated (GPU-backed) for ~2x our current peak throughput? I realize the detailed quote is next week, but a rough $/token range would help us in procurement pre-reads.
- SSO / SOC2: Procurement will want SOC2 Type II report and the SSO/SCIM checklist. Is Stephanie able to drop those into the HubSpot deal?

Also, on the latency note: we can instrument some additional traces on our side but we saw the biggest spikes when nightly indexing jobs overlapped with peak clinical search windows (around 2pm PT). If Dedicated can provide isolation for the indexing jobs or scheduling controls, that would ease our risk tolerance.

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

Appreciate the quick response, Alicia — great to lock people in. A few answers and next artifacts: 

1) Aug 10 deep-dive
- Connor is available 10am PT and I’ve penciled that in. I’ll send a calendar invite and include Daniel Park and Sara Li once you add them. Connor will cover embedding sizing, cache isolation options, and how Dedicated can isolate indexing workloads.

2) Ballpark pricing
- For Dedicated reserved capacity to cover ~2x peak throughput we typically see committed $/1K tokens in the range of $1.50–$2.50 for GPU-backed profiles depending on model family and commitment term. The formal proposal will have exact tiered numbers and optional burst/overage rates.

3) SOC2 & SSO
- Stephanie has uploaded the SOC2 Type II summary and the SSO/SCIM checklist to the HubSpot deal (link below). If procurement needs the full report or an attestation, Stephanie can coordinate an NDA and share through our security portal.

4) Proposal & contract
- Attached: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (commercial & term summary). I’ve also kicked off an internal pre-legal review; we’ll aim to get a redlined contract to you by Aug 12.
- DocuSign link for the initial term sheet will be included once legal confirms the final language.

Next steps (short):
- I’ll send the calendar invite for Aug 10 (Connor lead).
- I’ll post the formal proposal and HubSpot notes by Aug 12.
- Target signature window: Aug 16–20 to ensure procurement can close before the Sep 15 renewal.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54321-SPECTRA-0458
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/ds/starts/FAKEID-12345
